section_title: Instructions and precautions to be taken during manufacturing and storage

children.content:
• • During processing maintain the area at temperature not more than 25°C and relative humidity not more than 55%.
  • • Ensure the cleanliness of the equipment and area to be used for manufacturing.
  • • Ensure all the equipments are calibrated before start of manufacturing.
  • • Check the dispensed raw material with the issue slip of raw material and fill the requisite details in columns provided.
  • • Wear hand gloves, nose mask and the protective wearing while in operation.
  • • Put appropriate status labels for all the equipment and containers during all the stages of processing.
  • • All manufacturing operations must be carried out under the supervision of production supervisor.
  • • All rejects must be recorded and destroyed under the supervision of competent staff.
  • • Competent staff means the person designated for the particular job with respect to the SOP.
  • • Store the intermediates and finished formulations at temperature not more than 25°C.

section_title: 1. Manufacturing procedure along with control parameters for critical steps:

children.content: • 1.1.1 Transfer empty tubes from store to production Decartoning area. Open the shipper, remove the tubes and load the tubes in cassette. Send the cassette in the tube filling area wrapping with polybag.
• 1.2.1 Prior to commencement for manufacturing, weigh and confirm the raw materials received are as per formulation order.

• 1.3.1.1 Take Purified water approx. 50 lit. in manufacturing vessel. Heat up to 65-70°C.
  • 1.3.1.2 Add Methyl paraben 0.150 Kg and Propyl Paraben 0.015 Kg, E.D.T.A Di Sodium 0.015 Kg respectively. Ensure dissolved completely.
  • 1.3.1.3 Add Carbomer- 940 1.500 kg into the water Phase Vessel with the help of spatula with continuous Stirring.
  • 1.3.1.4 Transfer the phase in to the main Manufacturing vessel with the help of vacuum. & continue stirrer and homogenizer., then cool the gel phase up to 42°C.

• 1.3.2.1 Add Purified water approx. 40 lit. Mono Propylene Glycol 15.000 kg into wax phase tank, heat it up to 40°C.
  • 1.3.2.2 Add Polysorbate -80 0.019 kg in to the Wax phase vessel and mix for 10 minutes.
  • 1.3.2.3 Add Metronidazole 1.125 kg in to the Wax phase vessel with continuous stirring then rinse the bag with purified water.
  • 1.3.2.4 Mix API phase for 10 minutes to get homogeneous mixing.
  • 1.3.2.5 Transfer both API phase to the main manufacturing tank with the help of vacuum.

• 1.3.3.1 Mix the phase with stirrer and homogenizer for 10 minutes.
  • 1.3.3.2 Take Tri ethanol Amine 1.071 kg in a container with purified water approx. 10 lit. Mix it well add in to Main mfg. vessel slowly mix with continuous stirrer for 10 minutes.
